data.rationale: The proposal matches the overall goal (aa.com flight search from Plan Travel > Flights, then search and sort), but it treats the search as a single from/to/date segment. It leaves out the multi-city flow with multiple segments and "Add another flight". It also doesn't name the sort option or the segments list as parameters, so an automation couldn't be built from it for the multi-city case.
